in_sanskrit.name: Hansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Hans’, which means ‘joy’ or ‘delight’. The name Hansh signifies the divine grace and blessings of the gods. It is believed that a child named Hansh is blessed with immense joy and happiness in life.
